description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [MAG and RES +50% (25s)], [Awoken Scion Sorceress], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast], [Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark)] and [Pulse of Life Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Scion Sorceress
description.text: Black Magic and Witch abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic and Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Pulse of Life Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Pulse of Life after using two Black Magic or Witch abilities
